meta.title: Conversion opens a prefilled create screen in a new tab

plan.title: RFQ conversion opens a prefilled new tab

steps.note: Run Settings → Convert to Auction → Continue and switch to the newly opened tab.
Assert the new tab reached a ready create screen.
Check the conversion flag required by the oracle on the new page.
Check that the conversion URL includes the source-stage parameter.
Assert a template is already applied without selecting one.
Assert the prefilled pricing sheet has rendered its template columns.
